items.quote: Please transfer the course fee no later than 14 days after the date of this invoice, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: This is a private company invoice, so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the stated period runs from the invoice's own date. Start: invoice date Fri 29 Jan 2027. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (29 Jan) is not counted, so counting begins 30 Jan 2027. A 14-day period ending under § 188 Abs. 1 BGB falls on Fri 12 Feb 2027. That day is a Friday and not a public holiday in Berlin (sender's seat) or NRW (recipient's region), so no § 193 BGB shift is needed. Due date: 12 Feb 2027 (send a day earlier to allow for bank transfer time under § 675s BGB).
